question: Who among the following broke a 30-year-old national record in the men's 5000 m when he clocked 13:25:65 at the Sound Running Track Meet in San Juan Capistrano, USA in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Avinash Sable.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Avinash Sable** is an Indian athlete who broke a **30-year-old national record** in the **men's 5000 m** when he clocked 13:25:65 at the Sound Running Track Meet in **San Juan Capistrano, USA in 2022.**
 
• At the **2022 Asian Games**, Avinash Sable won the **first gold medal **for India in the** steeplechase **and the** silver medal** in the 5000 meters.
 
• He hails from** Maharashtra.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Siddhanth Thingalaya** is an Indian athlete who is a **sprint hurdler.**

 
 
• **​**With a timing of **13.48 seconds**, set in **June 2017** at the **Altis Invitational Meet in the USA**, he now owns the national record in the** 110-meter hurdles. **
 
 
 
• **Rahamatulla Molla** is an Indian athlete who is a **long-distance runner.**
 
 
• **​**As a member of the Indian **4 x 100-meter relay team,** he took home a **bronze medal** from the 2010 Commonwealth Games.
 
 
 
• **Ayyasamy Dharun** is an Indian athlete who is a** sprinter.**
 
 
• **​**He competed in the **2016 Summer Olympics** in the 4 × 400-meter relay.
